name: dsb-mun-5-mcp
title: DSB MUN 5.0 Model Context Protocol Server
description: Exposes DSB MUN 5.0 conference data, committee agendas, schedule, and delegate rules as tools for AI agents.

tools.name: get_conference_info
tools.description: Returns core metadata about DSB MUN 5.0 including dates, venue, theme, and host school.

tools.name: list_committees
tools.description: Lists all 9 committees with agendas and grade eligibility.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Returns hour-by-hour schedule for Day 1 and Day 2.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Returns Secretariat email, Instagram handle, and leadership contact details.
